months.title: How running costs are counted
months.rule: Each thing you sell carries the same percentage of its price.
months.applied: {{month}}: its costs {{costs}} ÷ its sales {{sales}} = {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.lastMonth: {{month}}: at {{rateMonth}}'s rate until {{monthOnly}} ends: {{costs}} ÷ {{sales}} = {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.lastMonthRate: {{month}}: at {{rateMonth}}'s rate until {{monthOnly}} ends: {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.soFar: {{month}}: so far, from your first sale on {{day}}: {{costs}} ÷ {{sales}} = {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.soFarRate: {{month}}: so far, from your first sale on {{day}}: {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.soFarDone: {{month}}: from your first sale on {{day}} to the end of the month: {{costs}} ÷ {{sales}} = {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.soFarDoneRate: {{month}}: from your first sale on {{day}} to the end of the month: {{percent}} of each sale's price.
months.before: {{month}}: before running costs. The percentage shows on {{day}}, once you have 7 days of sales.
months.awaiting: {{month}}: no sales yet to share running costs over.
months.awaitingPast: {{month}}: no sales in that month, so nothing was shared.
months.none: {{month}}: no costs to share, so its sales carry none.
months.off: Running Costs and Expenses are off, so no running costs are counted.
months.costs: {{month}}: your costs for these days, {{costs}}, come off your profit.
months.notCarried: {{amount}} of them isn't carried by this month's sales yet: it still comes off your profit.
months.branch: Each branch carries your business's percentage.
